dict.string: HAVKAR uses the microphone for optional voice input in HAVKAR AI and for authorized telehealth voice/video sessions when clinically enabled.
HAVKAR uses your location only when you choose map features, personal trip recording, or nearby services. Precise location is never required to browse the rest of the app.

HAVKAR may keep recording a personal trip you started, with your explicit consent, including briefly when the screen is off. You can stop recording anytime. Background location is never used for silent tracking.

HAVKAR accesses your photo library only when you choose to upload images for listings, ads, profile, chat, travel memories, or support.
HAVKAR uses the camera for travel memories you capture inside Tickets, and for authorized telehealth video when clinically enabled. Camera access is never required for browsing.
